title: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery
one_liner: 结合 Gemini、程序种群和自动验证器演化算法，并用发现的启发式改善 Google 的计算与模型训练基础设施。

problem.text: 怎样让 LLM 不只提出算法想法，还能靠执行反馈反复改进，产出正确且有实用价值的程序？AlphaEvolve 面向可以机器评分的数学、算法与计算系统问题。人指定优化目标及验证标准，系统负责寻找实现。

gap.text: FunSearch 等早期方法主要演化单个较短函数；复杂发现往往需要同时改动多个函数、用更丰富上下文并支持较昂贵的评估。AlphaEvolve 扩展到较大代码块、多指标与分布式异步评估，但不消除人工构造可靠评分器的必要性。

method.text: 从程序库采样父程序和启发示例，构造包含历史代码、分数与任务背景的提示；Gemini 2.0 Flash/Pro 提出差异块，应用后执行评估，将结果放回种群。级联测试先排除错误程序，再做昂贵验证；数据库结合 MAP-Elites 与岛式种群思想维持多样性，也可演化提示。

trace.text: Borg 调度案例把待调度作业的 CPU/内存需求和候选机器余量输入启发式，输出机器优先级。系统用历史工作负载模拟器演化这个函数，再在未见工作负载测试；通过后部署全机群，并以生产测量确认平均回收 0.7% 的原本闲置算力。

inputs_outputs.text: 输入为标出可演化代码块的初始程序、evaluate 函数、可选数学背景与 LLM 配置；输出为改进程序、候选历史和验证结果。程序可以直接是解，也可以是寻找数学构造的搜索算法。本文是系统白皮书，产出还包括张量分解和计算基础设施优化案例。

results.text: 论文报告 4×4 复数矩阵乘法用 48 次标量乘法，特定代数域和计数方式不能省略。工程案例中，Gemini 矩阵乘内核的分块启发式平均加速 23%，对应整体训练时间减少 1%；两者不是同一个比例。调度案例另报告 0.7% 机群资源回收。消融支持演化、上下文及强模型组合的作用。

contributions.text: 将通用 LLM 代码演化落实到可验证的科学构造和真实生产基础设施，而非只做固定题库。其与 RSI 的实际关联是改进自身底层模型的未来训练过程和计算资源，并展示可复用的“提案—执行—选择”发现管线。

limitations.text: 只能处理能构造可靠自动评估的问题；自然科学中需人工实验的步骤不在主要范围。Gemini 权重没有在同一演化循环里被自主更新，论文称基础设施反馈回路仍以月计。生产案例不能单独证明改进机制持续加速或开放式 RSI。

cost.text: 需要模型推理、候选代码执行、评估集及异步调度基础设施。不同任务可从秒级评估扩展到加速器小时级评估；没有一个可代表全部案例的统一预算。公开数学构造可核查，Google 内部工作负载与生产栈的复现条件不同。

relevance.text: 知识库分析：RSI 邻近的算法与基础设施改进证据，用来区分“优化支撑自己的系统”和“自主递归地优化整个改进过程”。这里的代码可读性也不等于神经网络机制可解释性；本文未验证解释驱动的 RSI。

related.reason: 两者均用 LLM 提案与经验评测维持程序种群；AlphaEvolve 主要演化任务算法，DGM 主要演化执行任务的 Agent。

classification_reason: 优化算法与训练计算基础设施，未验证演化后的改进器承担下一轮改进；作为 RSI 邻近背景保留。

rsi_evidence.status: 邻近背景 · 未验证递归闭环
rsi_evidence.next_round_role: 论文未验证演化后的改进器用于后续自改。
rsi_evidence.fixed_components: 程序种群、候选生成与验证框架提供外部优化过程。
rsi_evidence.capability_evidence: 算法与计算基础设施收益不能直接视为 Agent 后续自改能力增强。

en.one_liner: AlphaEvolve combines Gemini, a population of programs and automated evaluators to evolve algorithms, including heuristics used in Google’s compute and model-training infrastructure.

sections.problem: How can an LLM use execution feedback to turn algorithm ideas into correct, useful programs? AlphaEvolve targets mathematical, algorithmic and systems problems with machine-checkable scores. People specify the objective and validation criteria, while the system searches for implementations.
sections.gap: Earlier approaches such as FunSearch mainly evolved a single short function. More complex discoveries may require edits across functions, richer context and expensive evaluation. AlphaEvolve supports larger code regions, multiple metrics and distributed asynchronous evaluation. Reliable scoring still has to be designed by people.
sections.method: The system samples parent programs and examples from a database, then prompts Gemini 2.0 Flash and Pro with code, scores and task context. The models propose code diffs, which are applied and evaluated before returning to the population. A test cascade rejects invalid candidates before expensive checks. MAP-Elites and island-population ideas preserve diversity, and prompts can also evolve.
sections.trace: In the Borg scheduling case, a heuristic receives job CPU and memory requirements and available machine capacity, then ranks candidate machines. AlphaEvolve evolves it in a simulator using historical workloads and tests it on unseen workloads. After deployment across the fleet, production measurements showed that it reclaimed an average 0.7% of previously idle compute.
sections.inputs_outputs: The system takes an initial program with editable regions, an evaluate function, optional mathematical context and an LLM configuration. It returns improved programs, candidate histories and validation results. A program may itself solve a problem or search for a mathematical construction. The white paper includes tensor decompositions and infrastructure optimizations.
sections.results: The paper reports a 4 × 4 complex matrix multiplication algorithm using 48 scalar multiplications, under the stated algebra and counting convention. A tiling heuristic for Gemini matrix-multiplication kernels gave an average 23% speedup, corresponding to a 1% reduction in overall training time. The scheduling case separately reclaimed 0.7% of fleet resources. Ablations support the roles of evolution, context and stronger-model combinations.
sections.contributions: The work applies LLM-driven code evolution to verifiable mathematical constructions and production infrastructure. Its connection to RSI includes improving resources and future training processes for its underlying models. It also demonstrates a reusable proposal, execution and selection workflow for discovery.
sections.limitations: The approach needs reliable automated evaluators. Scientific steps requiring physical experiments are largely outside its scope. Gemini’s weights are not autonomously updated within the same evolution loop, and the paper describes infrastructure feedback loops on a scale of months. Production gains alone do not establish continually accelerating or open-ended RSI.
sections.cost: Costs include model inference, candidate execution, evaluation data and asynchronous scheduling infrastructure. Evaluations range from seconds to accelerator-hours, with no single budget representative of all cases. Published mathematical constructions are inspectable, while Google’s internal workloads and production stack have different reproducibility constraints.
sections.relevance: Library analysis. AlphaEvolve provides evidence about algorithm and infrastructure improvement adjacent to RSI. It helps distinguish optimizing supporting systems from recursively optimizing the improvement process itself. Readable code also differs from mechanistic interpretability of a neural network. The paper does not test explanation-driven RSI.

related.darwin-godel-machine: Both maintain program populations using LLM proposals and empirical evaluation. AlphaEvolve mainly evolves task algorithms, while DGM mainly evolves the agent performing the tasks.
